authorInfo.bio: T. (Tobias) Smollett (1721–1771) is the credited author of this historical edition. Works available in this collection include The Expedition of Humphry Clinker, The Adventures of Ferdinand Count Fathom — Complete, The Adventures of Roderick Random. The linked author record provides further bibliographic details.
